newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst, BASF plan plastics jv.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst, BASF plan plastics jv.

text.p: German chemical group Hoechst AG said on Thursday that it planned to set up with BASF AG an equal partnership joint venture to expand their activities in the market for polypropylene.
Hoechst said the two companies had signed an agreement to establish a 50-50 joint venture covering research and development, production, marketing and distribution of the thermoplastic material.
Polypropylene is used in production of bottles, pipes and fibres such as upholstery, ropes and carpets. The statement descibed polypropylene as a "growth market".
The new company would broaden the partners' technological know-how and regional presence, the statement said.
